description_th: Conservative deep preset for healthcare and wellness communication, focusing on education, trust, access, privacy, and compliance.
description_en: Conservative deep preset for healthcare and wellness communication, focusing on education, trust, access, privacy, and compliance.
campaign_duration: 6-10 weeks education, awareness, or appointment-support window
budget_range: THB 1M-10M test budget; replace with approved media and compliance plan
primary_kpi: Trust lift, message clarity, appointment consideration, privacy concern rate
competitor_context: Hospitals, clinics, wellness brands, pharmacy chains, telehealth platforms, and creator-led education.
brand_constraints: Do not provide personal medical advice, diagnosis, outcome promises, or unsupported health claims.
risk_legal_notes: Review professional advertising rules, Thai FDA/health claim rules, PDPA consent, testimonial rules, and clinical/compliance approval.

archetypes.narrative_th: Looks for trustworthy explanations, transparent costs, and clear next steps for family healthcare decisions.
Interested in wellness routines and evidence, but skeptical of exaggerated claims.
Worries about health data collection, retargeting, and sensitive information appearing in ads.
Reads reviews about waiting time, staff attitude, billing clarity, and doctor communication before choosing a provider.

crisis_scenarios.trigger: Users challenge a wellness claim and ask whether the message is medically approved.
Users ask why sensitive care-related ads appear after visiting a landing page.
The brand publishes general education content with clear professional review and next-step guidance.

document_seeds.description_th: Starter brief for conservative healthcare or wellness education.
document_seeds.description_en: Starter brief for conservative healthcare or wellness education.
document_seeds.content:
# Healthcare / Wellness Education Brief

Offering: [service or education topic]
Objective: improve trust and clarity while respecting privacy and compliance.
Audience: family care coordinators, wellness optimizers, privacy-sensitive users, service review readers.
Proof: professional review, general education sources, transparent next steps, privacy notice.
Risks: personal medical advice, unsupported health claims, sensitive retargeting, testimonial concerns.
Validation: clinical/compliance review, legal review, privacy review, and segment clarity test.

common_objections: Cost or next step is unclear
Sensitive data may be used in ads
channel_behavior: Facebook and LINE carry family questions
Instagram and TikTok need conservative captions and disclaimers
deep_preset.sample_brief: Run a conservative education campaign that improves trust and appointment consideration without giving personal medical advice.
sample_action_plan_hints: Make next step and cost boundaries clear
assumptions: This preset is for communication planning and does not provide medical, clinical, or legal advice.
All healthcare and wellness messages require qualified professional and legal review.
limitations: Does not assess patient suitability, clinical outcomes, or treatment decisions.
Does not replace professional compliance approval.
